declare
 t_dummy varchar2(1) := 'n' ;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 /*
 if :valid_notation_codes.notation_code != regexp_replace(:valid_notation_codes.notation_code,'[[:punct:]]') then
 show_error('5021');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if ; 
 */
 
 -- MLT 1267 returns null if matches: a to z OR A to Z or 0 to 9 or -
 if regexp_replace(:valid_notation_codes.notation_code, '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]*$') is not null then
 show_error('5021');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;

 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT') THEN
 begin 
 select distinct 'y'
 into t_dummy
 from valid_notation_codes
 where notation_code = :valid_notation_codes.notation_code ;
 
 if t_dummy = 'y' then
 show_error('5238');
 check_package_failure;
 end if ;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null ;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 
begin

 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 if from_where = 'E' then
 if trunc(eff_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if term_date is not null and trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if from_where = 'T' and term_date is not null then
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
end validate_dates;
